snippet.title: 【ENG】METAL SLUG ULTIMATE COLLECTION ｜Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
10 METAL SLUG titles, including the legendary location test build, are coming together in METAL SLUG ULTIMATE COLLECTION, launching in 2027!

■Titles Included
METAL SLUG (1996)
METAL SLUG 2 (1998)
METAL SLUG X (1999)
METAL SLUG 3 (2000)
METAL SLUG 4 (2002)
METAL SLUG 5 (2003)
METAL SLUG ADVANCE (2004)
METAL SLUG 6 (2006)
METAL SLUG 7 (2008)
Legendary METAL SLUG Location Test Build (making its official debut in this collection)

MISSION REBOOT! Special programs celebrating the 30th anniversary, coming one after another!
https://www.snk-corp.co.jp/us/anniversary/metalslug30th/
